name: SearchTrain
description: Searches for train information including pricing, schedules, and duration.

required_parameters.name: departure
required_parameters.description: Starting location of the train journey

required_parameters.name: destination
required_parameters.description: Final destination of the train journey

required_parameters.name: return_info
required_parameters.description: List of details to be returned in response, with options such as 'all', 'trainID', 'Ticket' (price), 'ArriveBy', 'leaveAt'. If the user does not specify what information is needed, select 'all'; otherwise, fill in the corresponding name.

optional_parameters.name: day
optional_parameters.description: The date for the train search

optional_parameters.name: leaveAt
optional_parameters.description: Desired time of departure (requires either leaveAt or arriveBy)

optional_parameters.name: arriveBy
optional_parameters.description: Desired time of arrival (requires either leaveAt or arriveBy)

name: BookTrain
description: Enables users to book train tickets.

required_parameters.name: people
required_parameters.description: Number of passengers for the booking

required_parameters.name: trainID
required_parameters.description: The identifier of the train to be booked

optional_parameters.name: return_info
optional_parameters.description: Details that the user will receive after booking, including options like 'all', 'isSuccess', 'reference', 'Ticket'. If the user does not specify what information is needed, select 'all'; otherwise, fill in the corresponding name.

name: SearchRestaurant
description: Allows users to search for restaurant information based on various filters.

required_parameters.name: area
required_parameters.description: The area where the restaurant is located.

optional_parameters.name: priceRange
optional_parameters.description: The price range of the restaurant.

optional_parameters.name: food
optional_parameters.description: Type of food or cuisine offered.

optional_parameters.name: return_info
optional_parameters.description: Information to be returned, can include options such as 'all', 'name', 'address', 'phone'.

name: BookRestaurant
description: Allows users to make restaurant reservations.

required_parameters.name: people
required_parameters.description: Number of people for the reservation.

optional_parameters.name: return_info
optional_parameters.description: Information that will be returned, including options such as 'all', 'name', 'phone', 'address', 'postcode'.
